001: Ivan, hi! Could you help me? I can't open this window.
Of course, Anna. Let me try. It's just stuck.
Thank you so much! I've been struggling with it for half an hour.
Oh, great! You really saved me.
Don't mention it. Let me know if you need anything else.
002: Dmitry, sorry to bother you. Do you have a minute?
I can't figure out this printer. It keeps jamming the paper.
Let me take a look. Did you load the paper correctly?
I thought I did. But maybe I mixed something up.
It's okay. I'll fix it right now, it won't take long.
003: Sergey, could you help me carry the bags? They're really heavy.
No problem, Anna. Give me one.
Oh, thanks! I didn't expect it to be this heavy.
No surprise there. What did you put in there? Bricks?
Well, let's go. It's not far from here.
004: Alexey, hi! Could you lend me your laptop for the evening?
Hi, Maria. What's wrong with yours?
It won't turn on. And I need to send an email urgently.
I see. Of course, take it. Just the battery is weak, so you'd better plug in the charger.
Okay, I'll keep that in mind. Thank you so much!
Don't mention it. I hope yours gets fixed soon.
005: Ivan, could you tell me how to get to the central market?
Sure, Olga. You need to take bus number five.
And which stop should I get off at?
The third one. There'll be a big shopping center, and the market is right behind it.
Got it. And is it a long ride?
About twenty minutes, if there's no traffic.
006: Dmitry, I have a big favor to ask you.
Could you pick up my package from the post office? I'll be at work late.
Sure, no problem. What do I need to say?
Just give them my last name and show your passport.
Great. I'll stop by there after work and take care of it.
007: Sergey, help me move the wardrobe, please.
Let's try, Anna. It's probably heavy.
Yeah, I can't do it alone. And I need to move it into the corner.
Okay, let's do it. You grab that end, and I'll grab this one.
008: Alexey, could you check my essay? I'm afraid there are a lot of mistakes.
Of course, Maria. Give it here. I'll take a quick look.
Thanks. It's really important for me to do well on it.
Don't worry. It's all pretty good, but a couple of spots need fixing.
Right here, it's better to replace this word and fix the ending.
009: Ivan, do you know where I can get my shoes repaired quickly?
I do, Olga. There's a small workshop on the corner.
I think so. They usually work until eight in the evening.
Then you'd better go there now, before they close.
010: Dmitry, could you help me set up my new phone?
Of course, Elena. What needs to be done?
I want to transfer my contacts from the old one. I have no idea how to do it.
It's not hard. Give me both phones for a minute.
Here you go. Thanks for agreeing to help.
Done. All your contacts are there. Everything works now.
